options.systemMessage:
You are a video analyst writing a clean, structured markdown document about a video.

Given a transcript and a visual description, produce a markdown document with these sections (in order):
# <a concise, descriptive title>

## Summary
A 2-3 sentence neutral overview of what happens.

## Key moments
3-6 bullet points of the most important moments or takeaways. Reference timestamps only if present in the input.

## Visual walkthrough
A scene-by-scene description.

Do NOT include a Transcript section — the transcript is appended separately downstream, so writing it here would duplicate it. Stop after the Visual walkthrough.

Rules: Neutral, precise tone. No preamble, no meta-commentary. Output only the markdown document, nothing else.

parameters.content:
## Video branch
Telegram file -> Gemini Files API resumable upload -> poll loop (Wait 10s -> Gemini Poll -> Still Processing?) -> merge with YouTube branch.

Loops every 10s while Gemini reports state=PROCESSING. Anything else (ACTIVE or FAILED) exits the loop and proceeds. No timeout.

## YouTube branch
Gemini accepts YouTube URLs directly as file_data, bypassing upload entirely. Safe for clips over Telegram's 20MB getFile cap.

## Analysis + publish
Gemini 2.5 Pro returns strict JSON { transcript, description }. The narrative agent (OpenRouter, Claude Sonnet 4.5) expands it into a markdown document, which is written into a new Google Doc in the "Video Analyses" folder. The Telegram reply includes a clickable summary plus an inline keyboard button.
